title: Summative Test 1 — Chemical Reactions & Safety
revision: 2026-11 rev2 — 70:30 LOTS:HOTS, balanced choices, in-scope items only

questions.text: Substances present at the START of a chemical reaction are called…
options: Reactants
Products
Catalysts
Precipitates
questions.correct: Reactants

questions.text: What are the products when an acid reacts with a carbonate?
options: A salt, water and carbon dioxide
A salt and hydrogen gas only
Oxygen and water vapor only
Carbon monoxide and black soot only
questions.correct: A salt, water and carbon dioxide

questions.text: Which observation is the STRONGEST evidence of a chemical change?
options: A new gas forms when two substances mix
A solid melts when it is heated slowly
A liquid takes the shape of its new container
A sugar cube breaks into smaller grains
questions.correct: A new gas forms when two substances mix

questions.text: Why does iron rust faster near the sea?
options: Salt and moisture speed up its reaction with oxygen
Sea breezes are cold and freeze the iron's outer surface
Sunlight at the beach melts the protective paint
Sea air has no oxygen, so iron reacts with salt
questions.correct: Salt and moisture speed up its reaction with oxygen

questions.text: Which is an example of DECOMPOSITION?
options: Hydrogen peroxide breaking into water and oxygen
LPG burning with oxygen in a kitchen stove
Vinegar reacting with baking soda in a cup
Zinc reacting with an acid to release hydrogen gas
questions.correct: Hydrogen peroxide breaking into water and oxygen

questions.text: Why is carbon monoxide called a silent killer?
options: It has no color or smell but blocks oxygen in blood
It makes a loud noise that damages the ear
It smells sweet, so people breathe in more
It only affects people who are already asleep in bed at night
questions.correct: It has no color or smell but blocks oxygen in blood

questions.text: Puto made with old, damp baking powder comes out flat. Which explanation applies reaction knowledge correctly?
options: The acid and bicarbonate already reacted, so little CO₂ was left
The damp powder turned into heavy salt that pressed the batter flat
Moisture made the powder release too much hydrogen gas
Old baking powder only reacts in very cold water
questions.correct: The acid and bicarbonate already reacted, so little CO₂ was left

questions.text: A student needs to identify a gas from a reaction. A lit splint makes a squeaky pop. Which reaction most likely produced it?
options: Acid reacting with a metal
Acid reacting with a carbonate
Complete combustion of LPG
Decomposition of limestone
questions.correct: Acid reacting with a metal

questions.text: What does the law of conservation of mass state?
options: Atoms are rearranged, not created or destroyed
Products always weigh more than the reactants
Mass disappears whenever a gas is produced
Only solids keep their mass in reactions
questions.correct: Atoms are rearranged, not created or destroyed

questions.text: How many hydrogen atoms are in 3H₂O?
Which equation represents cellular respiration?
options: C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ → 6CO₂ + 6H₂O + energy
6CO₂ + 6H₂O + light → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂
2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O + light energy
CH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O + heat energy
questions.correct: C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ → 6CO₂ + 6H₂O + energy

questions.text: Where does photosynthesis take place?
options: Chloroplasts
Mitochondria
Ribosomes
Vacuoles
questions.correct: Chloroplasts

questions.text: Which is ANABOLISM?
options: Joining amino acids to build muscle proteins
Breaking down glucose to release usable energy
Digesting rice starch into simple sugars
Breaking fat into smaller fatty acids
questions.correct: Joining amino acids to build muscle proteins

questions.text: Why do enzymes matter in body cells?
options: They speed up reactions at body temperature
They provide all the energy for every reaction
They are used up after each reaction
They slow reactions so cells stay safe
questions.correct: They speed up reactions at body temperature

questions.text: Which coefficients balance __Fe + __O₂ → __Fe₂O₃?
A runner breathes faster and deeper during a race. Which reasoning BEST uses the respiration equation?
options: More glucose is broken down, needing more O₂ and releasing more CO₂
More glucose is made, so the lungs release extra oxygen into the air
Less ATP is needed, so the lungs work harder to cool the body
Photosynthesis in the muscles needs more carbon dioxide to work
questions.correct: More glucose is broken down, needing more O₂ and releasing more CO₂

questions.text: Which property shows that seawater is a solution, not a suspension?
options: Its particles do not settle or filter out
It is blue when seen from far away
It has many fish and seaweed living in it
It moves in waves along the shoreline
questions.correct: Its particles do not settle or filter out

questions.text: Air is a solution. Which is its solvent?
options: Nitrogen
Oxygen
Carbon dioxide
Water vapor
questions.correct: Nitrogen

questions.text: What happens to the solubility of most solids as water gets hotter?
options: It increases
It decreases
It stays the same
It drops to zero
questions.correct: It increases

questions.text: Which is a DILUTE solution?
options: A spoon of sugar in a large pitcher of water
A cup of sugar in a small glass of water
Thick brine used to preserve dried fish (tuyo)
Syrup made by boiling sugar until thick
questions.correct: A spoon of sugar in a large pitcher of water

questions.text: What causes saltwater intrusion in coastal wells?
options: Over-pumping lets seawater seep into fresh groundwater
Rainwater carries dissolved salt down from the rain clouds
Fish release extra salt into the underground water
Sunlight turns the fresh water into salty water
questions.correct: Over-pumping lets seawater seep into fresh groundwater

questions.text: A 2-liter (2,000 mL) bottle of juice drink contains 10% real juice. How much real juice is in it?
options: 200 mL
20 mL
100 mL
questions.correct: 200 mL

questions.text: In a salt-and-plant experiment, the 0% salt seedlings grew 10 cm, the 1% grew 6 cm and the 3% grew 1 cm. What is the BEST conclusion?
options: More salt reduced plant growth
Salt had no effect on plant growth
More salt helped the plants grow taller
The 0% group had the most salt stress
questions.correct: More salt reduced plant growth

questions.text: What does the GHS corrosion pictogram warn about?
options: Burns to skin and eyes; damages metal
Fire risk near heat and open flames
Harm to fish and other aquatic life
Gas stored in tanks under very high pressure
questions.correct: Burns to skin and eyes; damages metal

questions.text: Why must bleach and ammonia cleaners never be mixed?
options: They react and release toxic chloramine gas
They cancel out and stop cleaning entirely
They form a solid that clogs the drain pipes
They turn into water and lose all their smell
questions.correct: They react and release toxic chloramine gas

questions.text: What is the safest way to smell a chemical in the lab?
options: Waft the vapor gently toward your nose
Put your nose right over the opening
Pour some on your hand and sniff it closely
Taste a small drop with your tongue
questions.correct: Waft the vapor gently toward your nose

questions.text: Why do phosphate detergents cause fish kills in creeks?
options: They feed algae; decay then uses up oxygen
They poison fish directly within minutes
They make the creek water too hot for fish
They block sunlight with a layer of soap
questions.correct: They feed algae; decay then uses up oxygen

questions.text: A cleaner splashes into your eye. What should you do FIRST?
options: Rinse with clean running water for 15–20 minutes
Rub the eye gently to remove the cleaner quickly
Wait to see if the stinging stops after an hour
Put a few drops of vinegar in the eye to neutralize
questions.correct: Rinse with clean running water for 15–20 minutes

questions.text: Two plans aim to protect a coastal rice area from salty wells. Plan A limits pumping and plants mangroves; Plan B digs deeper wells. Which is BETTER?
options: Plan A — it reduces the cause of intrusion
Plan B — deeper wells always reach fresh water
Plan B — it is faster and has no side effects
Plan A — because mangroves make the soil salty
questions.correct: Plan A — it reduces the cause of intrusion

questions.text: Your class must create a table on wastewater effects for your barangay. Which set of columns is MOST useful?
options: Source, effect on ecosystem, way to minimize it
Color, smell, price and brand of each product
Name of owner, address and phone number
Date, weather and the number of students present
questions.correct: Source, effect on ecosystem, way to minimize it
